title: Affiliate Disclosure
content:
Last updated: June 2026

Transparency matters. DudeVR.com is an affiliate-supported website, which means we may earn a commission when you click certain links and subscribe or purchase on a partner's site — at no extra cost to you.

How It Works

DudeVR showcases trailers, reviews and comparisons of VR adult content. Many of the outbound buttons and links on our pages — such as "Watch in VR" — are affiliate links. If you click one and later sign up or buy on the partner's website, we may receive a referral commission.

No Extra Cost to You

Using our affiliate links never increases the price you pay. Commissions are paid by the partner out of their own margin. They simply help us keep DudeVR running, online, and updated daily.

Our Partners

We work with established VR adult studios and networks, including VR Bangers, AR Porn, VR Conk, BlowVR, VRB Trans and VRB Gay, among others.

Editorial Honesty

Commissions do not buy positive coverage. Our rankings, scores and recommendations reflect genuine factors such as video quality, resolution, library size and update frequency. We aim to point you toward the best experience — whether or not a link is monetized.

Your Choice

You are never obligated to use our links. You can visit any studio directly. If you find our reviews useful, using our links is a free way to support the site.

Questions

Anything unclear? Email info@dudevr.com.

title: DMCA & Content Policy
content:
Last updated: June 2026

DudeVR.com respects intellectual property rights and complies with the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA). This page explains how content works on our site and how to request removal.

We Do Not Host Content

DudeVR is an affiliate review and discovery platform. We do not produce, host, or store any full-length videos on our servers. Trailers shown on the site are embedded or linked from the official websites of the respective producing studios (such as VR Bangers, AR Porn, VR Conk, BlowVR and others). All full videos reside on those partners' platforms and are subject to their terms.

18 U.S.C. § 2257 Statement

Because DudeVR does not produce or host adult content, it is not a producer (primary or secondary) of any depiction of actual or simulated sexually explicit conduct as defined in 18 U.S.C. § 2257. Records required by § 2257 are maintained by the original producing studios, who are the custodians of records for the content they create. All performers depicted by our partners were 18 years of age or older at the time of production.

Copyright Takedown (DMCA Notice)

If you believe content linked from DudeVR infringes your copyright, please first contact the studio actually hosting the material. If you still wish to notify us, send a written notice to info@dudevr.com including:

  • Your physical or electronic signature;
  • Identification of the copyrighted work claimed to be infringed;
  • The exact URL(s) on DudeVR where the material appears;
  • Your contact information (email, address, phone);
  • A statement that you have a good-faith belief the use is not authorized;
  • A statement, under penalty of perjury, that the information is accurate and that you are the rights holder or authorized to act on their behalf.

Upon a valid notice, we will promptly remove or disable access to the identified link(s).

Counter-Notice

If you believe your material was removed in error, you may submit a counter-notice to the same address with equivalent detail and a statement under penalty of perjury.

Content Concerns

To report any other content concern — including non-consensual material or anyone who may appear underage — email info@dudevr.com immediately. We take such reports seriously and act without delay.

title: Privacy & Cookies
content:
Last updated: June 2026

This Privacy & Cookie Policy explains what information DudeVR.com collects, how we use it, and the choices you have. DudeVR is an adult content directory and review site intended strictly for adults aged 18 or older.

Who We Are

DudeVR.com ("we", "us", "the site") is an independent affiliate review platform that showcases trailers and reviews of virtual reality adult content produced by third-party studios. We do not host full-length videos ourselves. For any privacy question, contact us at info@dudevr.com.

Information We Collect

We aim to collect as little personal data as possible. Depending on how you use the site, this may include:

  • Usage data — pages visited, time on site, referring URLs, and general interaction, collected via analytics in aggregated form.
  • Technical data — IP address, browser type, device and operating system, processed by our hosting and security provider (Cloudflare) to deliver and protect the site.
  • Cookies — small files stored in your browser (see below).

We do not require registration and do not knowingly collect names, addresses, or payment details — any purchase happens on our partners' own websites under their privacy policies.

Cookies

We use cookies and similar technologies for essential functionality, to remember your preferences (including age and cookie consent), to measure traffic, and to support affiliate tracking. You can manage or withdraw consent at any time using the Cookie Settings link in the footer, or via your browser settings.

Third-Party Services

We rely on trusted third parties that may process limited data on our behalf:

  • Cloudflare — content delivery, caching and security.
  • Analytics — aggregated, non-identifying traffic measurement.
  • Affiliate partners — when you click a partner link, the destination studio may set its own cookies to attribute the referral. These are governed by the partner's privacy policy.

Affiliate Links

Many outbound links on DudeVR are affiliate links. See our Affiliate Disclosure for details. Clicking them may pass a referral identifier to the partner, but no personal data is sold.

Your Rights (GDPR/CCPA)

Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your data, to object to or restrict processing, and to data portability. To exercise any right, email info@dudevr.com. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

Data Retention

Aggregated analytics are retained only as long as needed to understand site performance. Consent records are kept as required to demonstrate compliance.

Age Restriction

This site is for adults 18+ only. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you are not of legal age in your jurisdiction, please leave the site.

Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date reflects the latest revision.

Contact

Questions? Email info@dudevr.com.
